		cost = 0
		visible = {
			event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc
					event_target:ht_focus_state = { OWNER = { has_completed_focus = ARG_support_the_spanish_republicans } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_com
					event_target:ht_focus_state = {
						OWNER = {
							has_focus_tree = argentine_focus_tree
							NOT = { has_completed_focus = ARG_support_the_spanish_republicans }
							AND = {

			NOT = { has_global_flag = scw_over }
			any_other_country = {
				original_tag = SPR
				OR = {
					has_completed_focus = SPR_the_anti_fascist_workers_revolution
					has_completed_focus = SPR_maintain_the_second_republic
				}
			}
		
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } } }
			event_target:ht_focus_state = {
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc } }
						uncomplete_national_focus = { focus = ARG_support_the_spanish_republicans uncomplete_children = yes refund_political_power = yes }
					}
					else = {
						complete_national_focus = ARG_support_the_spanish_republicans
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = ht_note_a
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ht_notify_cd } } set_country_flag = { flag = ht_notify_cd days = 1 } news_event = { id = hosttool.73 } }
			}
		}
	}

		cost = 0

				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_com
					event_target:ht_focus_state = {
						OWNER = {
							has_focus_tree = australia_taog_focus
							NOT = { has_completed_focus = AST_the_publics_australia }
							AND = {

			has_idea = AST_nationalizing_spirit
		
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } } }

				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc } }
						uncomplete_national_focus = { focus = AST_the_publics_australia uncomplete_children = yes refund_political_power = yes }
					}
					else = {
						complete_national_focus = AST_the_publics_australia

			}

		}

					event_target:ht_focus_state = { OWNER = { has_completed_focus = BUL_follow_the_stalinist_doctrine } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_com
					event_target:ht_focus_state = {
						OWNER = {
							has_focus_tree = bulgarian_focus
							NOT = { has_completed_focus = BUL_follow_the_stalinist_doctrine }
							AND = {

			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { country_exists = SOU }
						NOT = { SOU = { has_government = communism } }
						is_in_faction_with = SOU
					}
				}
				#This is intended so that the focus does not look unavailable when it is actually bypassed
			}
			else = {
				SOU = {
					has_government = communism
					is_faction_leader = yes
					is_subject = no
					has_civil_war = no
					NOT = { is_justifying_wargoal_against = ROOT }
					NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
				}
				SOU = { #Split for easier visualization in the tooltip
					has_opinion	= {
						target = ROOT
						value > 50
					}
				}
				is_in_faction = no
				is_subject = no
			}
		
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } } }
			event_target:ht_focus_state = {
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc } }
						uncomplete_national_focus = { focus = BUL_follow_the_stalinist_doctrine uncomplete_children = yes refund_political_power = yes }
					}
					else = {
						complete_national_focus = BUL_follow_the_stalinist_doctrine
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = ht_note_a
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ht_notify_cd } } set_country_flag = { flag = ht_notify_cd days = 1 } news_event = { id = hosttool.73 } }

		cost = 0
		visible = {
			event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc
					event_target:ht_focus_state = { OWNER = { has_completed_focus = construction_effort_2 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_com
					event_target:ht_focus_state = {
						OWNER = {
							has_focus_tree = generic_focus
							NOT = { has_completed_focus = construction_effort_2 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } } }
			event_target:ht_focus_state = {
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc } }
						uncomplete_national_focus = { focus = construction_effort_2 uncomplete_children = yes refund_political_power = yes }
					}
					else = {
						complete_national_focus = construction_effort_2
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = ht_note_a
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ht_notify_cd } } set_country_flag = { flag = ht_notify_cd days = 1 } news_event = { id = hosttool.73 } }
			}
		}
	}
